system.title: System
system.lead: The versions, the programs that run in the background, updates, the rebuild kit and the settings backup of this computer.
system.loading: Reading the state of this computer …
system.servicesWhy: The programs that run in the background. Restart one when it is stopped or has problems.
system.restartWhy.llama: The AI brain stops for up to a minute. An answer that is being written is cut off. The models that were loaded are loaded again.
system.restartWhy.kiwix: The library stops for a few seconds.
system.restartWhy.whisper: Speech to text stops for a few seconds.
system.catalogWhy: The catalog is the list of content and AI models this computer can have. It uses the internet.
system.catalogSame: You already have the newest catalog ({version}).
system.updateWhy: Downloads the newest version of Local AI, checks that it is genuine and installs it. Local AI restarts; the AI models keep running. It uses the internet.
system.updated: Updated to version {to}. Local AI restarted.
system.upToDate: You already have the newest version ({version}).
system.password: The computer will ask for your login password (the administrator password).
system.kitWhy: The rebuild kit has what is needed to repair or reinstall Local AI without the internet.
system.kitReady: Ready: all {n} parts are here and checked.
system.kitPartial: {ready} of {n} parts are ready. The others are downloaded with the internet (Offline content, Sync now).
system.kitNone: This computer's plan has no rebuild kit.
system.kitCheckWhy: Reads the kit's files again to make sure none is damaged. It can take several minutes.
system.kitGreen: The rebuild kit is complete and undamaged.
system.kitYellow: The rebuild kit can be used, with warnings.
system.kitRed: Parts of the rebuild kit are missing or damaged. Open Health and run a full check to see which.
system.backupWhy: Saves this computer's settings in a file on the AI-ARK drive. Connect the drive first. The file holds this computer's keys, so keep the drive in a safe place.
system.backupTitle: Save the settings on the AI-ARK drive?
system.backedUp: Saved on the AI-ARK drive ({n} files). Keep the drive in a safe place.
system.backedUpPlain: Saved on the AI-ARK drive. Keep the drive in a safe place.
system.restoreWhy: Puts back the newest settings backup of this computer, from this computer or the AI-ARK drive. The current files are kept as copies. Local AI restarts.
system.restorePin: Restoring replaces this computer's settings, so it needs the admin PIN.
system.restoredPlain: The settings were restored. Local AI restarted.
system.restoredNothing: Nothing to restore: the settings are already the same as the backup.
system.pinWhy: An expert does this at this computer's keyboard: the new PIN is typed twice in a terminal, so this app cannot do it for you.
system.desktopOnly: This button works in the Local AI app. In a web browser, give the command below to an expert.
system.cancelled: The password window was closed, or the password was not accepted. Press the button to try again.
system.busy: Another task that needs the password is still running. Wait for it to finish, then try again.
system.unavailable: This computer cannot show the password window. Give the command below to an expert.
system.timeout: It took too long and was stopped. Try again, or give the command below to an expert.
system.failedPlain: It stopped with an error. Give the command below to an expert.
